review_method: Full source read; read-only review. No independent namespace command was executed by this reviewer.
conclusion: No blocking defect identified within the stated descriptor-bound entry and direct-child lifecycle scope.
reviewed_properties: Command target selection uses the received namespace/root descriptors, without a numeric target PID.
Mandatory option/FD validation rejects duplicated options, authority FD numbers below 3, reused authority FD numbers and wrong namespace types.
All supplied authority descriptors are marked FD_CLOEXEC before the command exec; the caller must pass only that exact descriptor set.
Namespace entry is followed by fchdir(held_root), chroot('.'), chdir('/'), and fork into the selected PID namespace.
The launcher parent is checked around PR_SET_PDEATHSIG. The entry child sets its own parent-death signal then polls the held parent pidfd, avoiding getppid()==0 ambiguity across PID namespaces.
The parent closes its authority copies, waits for the exact child, handles EINTR and reports that child's result.
required_caller_boundaries: The caller must bind and verify that all namespace and root descriptors belong to one intended process generation.
The caller must keep all command subprocesses joined before releasing authority FDs.
PDEATHSIG does not cover the full descendant process tree: it is not inherited by forked children and may be cleared by credential changes such as su.
Existing command deadlines, exact package cleanup, full owned cell/systemd cleanup and final readback remain required.
Input qualification does not establish private Android signal behavior or commercial app readiness.

parent_actual_qualification.scope: Parent-executed 14 host controls, six-namespace entry and Main read-only entry; not independent execution by this reviewer.
